cs.t: I've been using the same Axio backpack for the last ~15 years. When I bought it, they gave lifetime guarantee. It still holds perfectly well after all this time, nothing broken. My MacBook Pro 15" fits well into this backpack by the way. I wonder if they still create backpacks of the same quality with lifetime guarantee. Could be bad for business :) My backpack looks quite a bit like this one:  http://www.digitalrendezvous.net/2008/06/08/urban-roaming/
cs.th: Ask HN: Do you carry a backpack? Which one?
